errors.alpha: Alpha must be a number between 0 and 1.
errors.anova1MoreValues: Single-factor Anova needs more values than groups.
errors.anova1NeedsTwoGroups: Single-factor Anova needs at least two groups.
errors.anova2NeedsRowsColumns: Two-factor Anova needs at least two rows and two columns of data.
errors.anova2NeedsTwoSamples: Two-factor Anova needs at least two samples.
errors.anova2repDivide: The data rows must divide evenly into samples of {n} rows.
errors.anova2repSelect: Select the labels and at least two columns and two samples of data.
errors.chooseStatistic: Choose at least one of the statistics to show.
errors.confidenceRange: The confidence level must be between 0% and 100%.
errors.correlationNeedsTwo: Correlation needs at least two variables.
errors.covarianceNeedsTwo: Covariance needs at least two variables.
errors.dampingRange: The damping factor must be between 0 and 1.
errors.differenceNumber: The hypothesized mean difference must be a number.
errors.discreteColumns: The value and probability range needs two columns: values and their probabilities.
errors.discreteNumbers: The value and probability range must hold numbers, with no negative probability.
errors.fourierComplex: Input range must hold numbers or complex numbers such as 3+2i in every cell.
errors.fourierPowerOfTwo: Fourier analysis needs 2, 4, 8, … up to 4096 values (a power of 2).
errors.ftestNoVariance: The second variable has no variance, so F cannot be worked out.
errors.groupNeedsNumber: Each group needs at least one number.
errors.intervalNeedsValues: The input needs at least {k} values for an interval of {k}.
errors.intervalWhole: The interval must be a whole number of 2 or more.
errors.knownVariance: Enter each known variance as a number greater than 0.
errors.kthLargestWhole: Kth largest must be a whole number of 1 or more.
errors.kthSmallestWhole: Kth smallest must be a whole number of 1 or more.
errors.lambdaPositive: Lambda must be a number greater than 0.
errors.noBlankCells: Input range must not hold blank cells.
errors.noDataBelowLabels: {name} has no data below its labels.
errors.noNewSheet: The workbook would not take a new sheet.
errors.normalParams: Enter a mean and a standard deviation of 0 or more.
errors.numberInEveryCell: Input range must hold a number in every data cell.
errors.oneNumberEach: Each variable needs at least one number.
errors.outputArray: The output range would change part of an array. Choose another place for the output.
errors.outputFailed: The output could not be written.
errors.outputProtectedCells: The output range holds protected cells. Choose another place for the output.
errors.outputProtectedSheet: The output range is on a protected sheet.
errors.pRange: The p value must be between 0 and 1.
errors.pairedBothValues: Each pair needs both of its values: a blank cell in one range must be blank in the other.
errors.pairedSameSize: A paired test needs two ranges of the same size.
errors.patternedOrder: The last number must not be less than the first.
errors.patternedParams: Enter the first and last numbers and a step greater than 0.
errors.periodTooLarge: The period cannot be more than the {count} values in the input.
errors.periodWhole: The period must be a whole number of 1 or more.
errors.probabilitiesSum: The probabilities must add up to 1.
errors.randomCountWhole: The number of random numbers must be a whole number of 1 or more.
errors.regressionFailed: The regression could not be worked out for this data.
errors.regressionMaxX: Regression takes at most 64 X columns.
errors.regressionMinRows: {k, plural, one {Regression with # X column needs at least {minRows} rows of data.} other {Regression with # X columns needs at least {minRows} rows of data.}}
errors.regressionNumbers: Regression needs a number in every row of the Y and X ranges.
errors.regressionSameRows: The Y range and the X range must have the same number of rows.
errors.regressionSelectX: Select at least one X column.
errors.repeatWhole: The repeat counts must be whole numbers of 1 or more.
errors.rowsPerSample: Rows per sample must be a whole number of 2 or more.
errors.sameObservations: Every variable needs the same number of observations.
errors.samplesWhole: The number of samples must be a whole number of 1 or more.
errors.smoothingNeedsTwo: Exponential smoothing needs at least two values.
errors.tooManyNumbers: That is more than a million numbers; ask for fewer.
errors.trialsWhole: The number of trials must be a whole number of 1 or more.
errors.ttestNoVariance: The samples have no variance, so t cannot be worked out.
errors.twoNumbersEach: Each variable needs at least two numbers.
errors.uniformBounds: Enter the two numbers the values fall between.
errors.variablesRange: The number of variables must be a whole number from 1 to 1000.
tools.tpaired: t-Test: Paired Two Sample for Means
